speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Lactation Jaundice).
The history of a 5-day-old exclusively breastfed infant with progressive jaundice and no change in stool color is consistent with insufficient intake rather than biliary obstruction. I recommend a follow-up to ensure weight gain and adequate hydration.
